test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) was placed in the Guinness Book of World Records for which of the following achievements?

options.text: Opening the largest number of bank accounts in one month
Opening the largest number of bank accounts in one week
Opening the largest number of bank accounts in one fortnight
Opening the largest number of bank accounts in one day

solution:
The correct answer is __**Opening the largest number of bank accounts in one week.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **In August 2014, the PMJDY opened 18,096,130 bank accounts in one week, which was recognized by the Guinness Book of World Records.**
 
• The Department of Financial Services, Government of India, has declared that the "Most bank accounts opened in one week as part of the Financial Inclusion Campaign is 18,096,130."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) was launched in August 2014 by the Indian government.**
 
• **Its aim of providing financial inclusion and banking services to all households in India. **
 
• The scheme offers basic savings bank deposit accounts (BSBDA) with no minimum balance requirement, a RuPay debit card, and insurance coverage.
 
• As of August 2021, the PMJDY has opened over 43 crore (430 million) bank accounts and mobilized over Rs 1.5 lakh crore (1.5 trillion) in deposits.
